works.title: Spoon and Saucer
works.oneLiner: Stir a cup of tea and the leaves creep into a heap. Turn the cup instead and they slide out into a ring.
works.thumbnailAlt: A white cup of amber tea from above on a saucer with a tick-marked rim, dark tea leaves scattered across the bottom.

works.title: Breath Figure
works.oneLiner: A night-bus window. Breathe on it and a stranger's marks surface in the fog. Write, and the glass keeps yours too.

connections.note: Shares the studio's habit of a phenomenon-first mechanism (phantom jam / breath figure) with no hand-set lever, tested in sim before painting.

works.thumbnailAlt: A dark bus window fogged by a milk-white breath disc, with a dark written line and smudged strangers' marks across it.

works.title: Plain Hunt
works.oneLiner: A bell you let go of strikes two seconds late. Hold, release, and watch the other bells bend to cover your slip.
works.thumbnailAlt: A pale slanted band of daylight over a cream wall, an umber bell on a hub with a slack rope to a red sally, and rows of small dots at left.

works.title: Phantom Jam
works.oneLiner: One pedal, a ring of cars at night: your brake starts a slowdown that comes back to you, and only a gentle hold dissolves it.
works.thumbnailAlt: A ring of small lights at night under a framed rear-view mirror, a few of them red.
